queries.sql: SELECT DATABASE(),VERSION(),@@server_uuid,CURRENT_USER(),@@SESSION.sql_mode [pool guard]

SELECT CONNECTION_ID(),DATABASE(),VERSION(),@@server_uuid,CURRENT_USER(), scoped table count
SELECT DATABASE(),VERSION(),@@server_uuid,CURRENT_USER(),@@SESSION.sql_mode [pool guard]
SET SESSION time_zone='+00:00'
SELECT CONNECTION_ID(),DATABASE(),VERSION(),@@server_uuid,CURRENT_USER(), scoped table count
SELECT * FROM proof_of_payment WHERE receipt_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(payment_id AS CHAR) id,amount,CAST(client_receipt_id AS CHAR) proofId FROM payment_transaction WHERE operation_key=?
SELECT * FROM sales_invoice WHERE invoice_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) amount FROM payment_transaction WHERE invoice_id=? AND approval_status='approved'
SELECT COUNT(*) total,COALESCE(SUM(d.storage_status='available'),0) available FROM proof_of_payment_file f JOIN document d ON d.document_id=f.document_id WHERE f.receipt_id=?
SELECT q.downpayment_amount FROM purchase_order p JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE p.po_id=?

INSERT INTO payment_transaction(invoice_id,payment_method_id,transaction_type,amount,date_paid,client_receipt_id,recorded_by_user_id,approved_by_user_id,approved_at,operation_key) VALUES (?,?,?,?,UTC_DATE(),?,?,?,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),?)
UPDATE sales_invoice SET status=? WHERE invoice_id=?
UPDATE proof_of_payment SET review_status=?,reviewed_by_user_id=?,reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),review_note=? WHERE receipt_id=? AND review_status='pending'

SELECT CAST(cl.client_id AS CHAR) id,cl.company_name companyName,cl.contact_person contactPerson,COALESCE(u.email,cl.email) email,u.username,COALESCE(u.phone,cl.phone) phone,CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) accountId,(u.status='active') active,(cl.status='active') companyActive,cl.client_since joinedOn,cl.created_at createdAt FROM client cl LEFT JOIN client_user cu ON cu.client_id=cl.client_id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id=cu.client_user_id WHERE cl.client_id=?
SELECT LOWER(role_name) code,role_name label FROM role ORDER BY role_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u JOIN role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id WHERE r.role_name<>'Client') employees,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u JOIN role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id WHERE r.role_name<>'Client' AND u.status='active') activeEmployees,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client) clients,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role) roles,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_applications WHERE application_status='pending') pendingApplications

SELECT CAST(a.audit_event_id AS CHAR) id,a.action,a.subject_type subjectType,CAST(a.subject_id AS CHAR) subjectId,a.occurred_at occurredAt FROM audit_event a WHERE a.action IN (?,?,?,?) ORDER BY a.audit_event_id DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT CAST(client_id AS CHAR) id,company_name companyName,status FROM client ORDER BY client_id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM client
SELECT CAST(role_id AS CHAR) id FROM role WHERE LOWER(role_name)=? AND role_name<>'Client'
SELECT audit_event_id FROM audit_event WHERE subject_type='user_account' AND action IN ('employee.created','employee.updated') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_value,'$.employeeId'))=? LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO user_account(role_id,full_name,email,username,phone,password_hash,status,must_change_password,joined_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,'active',1,UTC_DATE())
SELECT user_id FROM user_account WHERE user_id=? FOR UPDATE
UPDATE user_account SET full_name=?,email=?,username=?,phone=? WHERE user_id=?
UPDATE client SET company_name=?,contact_person=?,email=?,phone=? WHERE client_id=?
UPDATE user_account SET role_id=? WHERE user_id=?
UPDATE user_account SET status=? WHERE user_id=?
UPDATE client SET status=? WHERE client_id=?
UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=? AND revoked_at IS NULL
SELECT DATABASE() AS databaseName
SELECT GET_LOCK(?,2) AS acquired
SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(?) AS released

SELECT CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) userId,LOWER(r.role_name) roleCode,u.status,u.must_change_password mustChangePassword,
    CAST(cu.client_id AS CHAR) clientId,cl.status clientStatus FROM user_account u JOIN role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id
    LEFT JOIN client_user cu ON cu.client_user_id=u.user_id LEFT JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id=cu.client_id WHERE u.user_id=? FOR SHARE
SELECT CAST(q.inquiry_id AS CHAR) id FROM sales_invoice v JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=v.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE v.invoice_id=?

SELECT CAST(q.inquiry_id AS CHAR) id FROM proof_of_payment r JOIN sales_invoice v ON v.invoice_id=r.invoice_id JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=v.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE r.receipt_id=?
SELECT CAST(q.inquiry_id AS CHAR) id FROM job_order j JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=j.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE j.jo_id=?

SELECT CAST(q.inquiry_id AS CHAR) id FROM delivery d JOIN job_order j ON j.jo_id=d.jo_id JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=j.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE d.delivery_id=?
INSERT INTO audit_event(actor_user_id,action,subject_type,subject_id,before_value,after_value,reason) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO notification(user_id,title,message,notification_type) VALUES (?,?,?,?)
SELECT CAST(client_user_id AS CHAR) id FROM client_user WHERE client_id=?

SELECT CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) id FROM user_account u JOIN role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id WHERE LOWER(r.role_name)=? AND u.status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM client_user cu WHERE cu.client_user_id=u.user_id)

SELECT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_order j JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=j.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE q.inquiry_id=?) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_transaction t JOIN sales_invoice v ON v.invoice_id=t.invoice_id JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=v.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE q.inquiry_id=? AND t.transaction_type='DOWNPAYMENT' AND t.approval_status='approved')) blocked

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry WHERE status='inquiry') pendingInquiries,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quotation WHERE status='sent' AND is_current=1) quotationsSent,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order) purchaseOrdersReceived,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payment_transaction WHERE approval_status='approved') verifiedRevenue
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_paid,'%Y-%m') month,SUM(amount) amount FROM payment_transaction WHERE approval_status='approved' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date_paid,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
INSERT INTO document(file_name,mime_type,size_bytes,sha256,storage_status,uploaded_by_user_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,'pending',?)
UPDATE document SET storage_bucket=?,storage_key=?,object_generation=?,storage_status='available' WHERE document_id=? AND storage_status='pending'
SELECT delivery_method_id FROM delivery_method WHERE delivery_method_id=? AND is_active=1
SELECT CAST(quotation_id AS CHAR) id,terms_of_payment paymentTermCode FROM quotation WHERE inquiry_id=? AND is_current=1 AND status='accepted' FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO purchase_order(po_no,quotation_id,po_document_id,received_date,payment_terms,delivery_method_id,recorded_by_user_id) VALUES (?,?,?,UTC_DATE(),?,?,?)
UPDATE inquiry SET status='po' WHERE inquiry_id=?
SELECT v.* FROM sales_invoice v JOIN purchase_order p ON p.po_id=v.po_id JOIN quotation q ON q.quotation_id=p.quotation_id WHERE v.invoice_id=? AND q.inquiry_id=? FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO proof_of_payment(invoice_id,client_user_id,payment_method_id,amount_declared,note) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO proof_of_payment_file(receipt_id,document_id) VALUES (?,?)
SELECT audit_event_id FROM audit_event WHERE subject_type='delivery' AND subject_id=? AND action='delivery.handed_off' LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(m.material_id AS CHAR) id,m.material_name name,mc.category_name category,CAST(m.material_category_id AS CHAR) categoryId,CAST(m.uom_id AS CHAR) uomId,u.abbreviation unit,m.qty_in_stock qtyInStock,m.quantity_status quantityStatus,m.reorder_threshold threshold,m.threshold_status thresholdStatus,m.supplier_name supplier,m.unit_price approvedCostingPrice,m.reference_unit_price referenceUnitPrice,m.created_at createdAt,m.updated_at updatedAt FROM raw_material m JOIN unit_of_measure u ON u.uom_id=m.uom_id LEFT JOIN material_category mc ON mc.material_category_id=m.material_category_id WHERE m.is_active=1 ORDER BY m.material_name,m.material_id

SELECT CAST(finished_good_id AS CHAR) id,item_code itemCode,enterfil_pn enterFilPN,item_name name,CAST(client_id AS CHAR) clientId,qty_in_stock qtyInStock,quantity_status quantityStatus,buffer_min bufferMin,threshold_status thresholdStatus,demand_level demand FROM finished_good WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY item_code
SELECT * FROM raw_material WHERE material_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT uom_id FROM unit_of_measure WHERE uom_id=?
SELECT material_category_id FROM material_category WHERE material_category_id=?
INSERT INTO raw_material(material_name,material_category_id,uom_id,reorder_threshold,threshold_status,supplier_name) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)
SELECT movement_id FROM stock_movement WHERE raw_material_id=? LIMIT 1
UPDATE raw_material SET material_name=?,material_category_id=?,uom_id=?,reorder_threshold=?,threshold_status=?,supplier_name=? WHERE material_id=?
UPDATE raw_material SET qty_in_stock=NULL,quantity_status='unknown' WHERE material_id=?

INSERT INTO stock_movement(item_type,raw_material_id,movement_reason,quantity_status_before,qty_before,qty_after,qty_change,uom_id,performed_by_user_id,operation_key) VALUES ('raw_material',?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
UPDATE raw_material SET qty_in_stock=?,quantity_status='verified' WHERE material_id=?
SELECT CAST(quotation_id AS CHAR) id,quotation_no reference FROM quotation WHERE quotation_id=? AND inquiry_id=?
SELECT * FROM raw_material WHERE material_id=? AND is_active=1 FOR SHARE
INSERT INTO stock_request(inquiry_id,requested_by_user_id,status) VALUES (?,?,'pending')
INSERT INTO stock_request_item(stock_request_id,raw_material_id,qty_requested,stock_at_request,shortage_at_request,quantity_status_at_request,uom_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT CAST(sr.stock_request_id AS CHAR) id,CAST(sr.inquiry_id AS CHAR) orderId,i.inquiry_no orderReference,sr.status,sr.request_date createdAt,(SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_value,"$.clientReference")) FROM audit_event e WHERE e.subject_type="stock_request" AND e.subject_id=sr.stock_request_id AND e.action="stock_request.created" ORDER BY e.audit_event_id LIMIT 1) clientReference FROM stock_request sr JOIN inquiry i ON i.inquiry_id=sr.inquiry_id ORDER BY sr.request_date DESC

SELECT CAST(s.stock_request_item_id AS CHAR) id,CAST(s.raw_material_id AS CHAR) materialId,m.material_name materialName,s.qty_requested requiredQuantity,s.stock_at_request stockAtRequest,s.shortage_at_request shortageAtRequest,s.quantity_status_at_request quantityStatus,s.qty_available currentQuantity,s.available_quantity_status availableQuantityStatus,s.observed_at respondedAt FROM stock_request_item s JOIN raw_material m ON m.material_id=s.raw_material_id WHERE s.stock_request_id=? ORDER BY s.stock_request_item_id
SELECT CAST(inquiry_id AS CHAR) id FROM stock_request WHERE stock_request_id=?
SELECT * FROM stock_request WHERE stock_request_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM stock_request_item WHERE stock_request_id=? ORDER BY raw_material_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM raw_material WHERE material_id=? AND is_active=1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE stock_request_item SET qty_available=?,available_quantity_status='verified',observed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),observed_by_user_id=? WHERE stock_request_item_id=?
UPDATE stock_request SET status=?,handled_by_user_id=? WHERE stock_request_id=?
SELECT CAST(delivery_receipt_id AS CHAR) id,dr_no reference,CAST(document_id AS CHAR) documentId,generated_at generatedAt FROM delivery_receipt WHERE delivery_id=?
SELECT * FROM job_order WHERE jo_id=? FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO delivery(jo_id,delivery_method_id,status,estimated_delivery_date,driver_name,driver_contact,vehicle_plate,tracking_link) VALUES (?,?,'pending',?,?,?,?,?)
SELECT quantity FROM job_order_item WHERE jo_item_id=? AND jo_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(di.quantity),0) quantity FROM delivery_item di JOIN delivery d ON d.delivery_id=di.delivery_id WHERE di.jo_item_id=? AND d.status<>'cancelled'
INSERT INTO delivery_item(delivery_id,jo_item_id,quantity) VALUES (?,?,?)

UPDATE delivery SET status=?,dispatch_date=IF(?='in_transit',UTC_DATE(),dispatch_date),delivered_date=IF(? IN ('delivered','picked_up'),UTC_DATE(),delivered_date),dispatched_by_user_id=IF(?='in_transit',?,dispatched_by_user_id),received_by=COALESCE(?,received_by),tracking_link=COALESCE(?,tracking_link) WHERE delivery_id=?

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM job_order_item ji WHERE ji.jo_id=? AND ji.quantity>COALESCE((SELECT SUM(di.quantity) FROM delivery_item di JOIN delivery dx ON dx.delivery_id=di.delivery_id WHERE di.jo_item_id=ji.jo_item_id AND dx.status IN ('delivered','picked_up')),0)
UPDATE job_order SET status='delivered' WHERE jo_id=?
UPDATE inquiry SET status='delivered' WHERE inquiry_id=?

UPDATE sales_invoice v JOIN job_order j ON j.po_id=v.po_id SET v.delivered_date=UTC_DATE(),v.due_date=DATE_ADD(UTC_DATE(),INTERVAL IF(v.payment_terms='NET15',15,30) DAY) WHERE j.jo_id=? AND v.payment_terms IN ('NET15','NET30')
SELECT * FROM waybill WHERE delivery_id=? FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO waybill(delivery_id,waybill_no,qr_identifier,generated_by_user_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)
UPDATE waybill SET printed_at=COALESCE(printed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE waybill_id=?

SELECT document_id FROM document WHERE document_id=? AND uploaded_by_user_id=? AND storage_status='available' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audit_event e WHERE e.subject_type='document' AND e.subject_id=document.document_id AND e.action='delivery.document_uploaded' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_value,'$.deliveryId'))=?)
SELECT CAST(delivery_receipt_id AS CHAR) id,CAST(document_id AS CHAR) documentId FROM delivery_receipt WHERE delivery_id=? FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO delivery_receipt(delivery_id,dr_no,generated_by_user_id,document_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)
SELECT waybill_id FROM waybill WHERE delivery_id=? AND printed_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT r.delivery_receipt_id FROM delivery_receipt r JOIN delivery d ON d.delivery_id=r.delivery_id WHERE r.delivery_id=? AND d.status IN ('delivered','picked_up') AND
